description: Enhanced boundary coverage for the shared entity preamble (native-disjoint). The native case drives a LINE; these drive a CIRCLE carrying every common group code at once (handle, linetype name, owning layer, linetype scale, invisibility flag 60, color index, paper-space flag 67) and a LINE that sets only color and paper-space membership while visibility falls back to its default of true.

cases.expected_output:
type=circle
layer=mylayer
linetype=DASHED
linetype_scale=2.5
is_visible=false
is_in_paper_space=true
color=3
center=0,0,0
radius=10
normal=0,0,1
thickness=0

type=line
layer=0
linetype=BYLAYER
linetype_scale=1
is_visible=true
is_in_paper_space=true
color=2
p1=0,0,0
p2=0,0,0
thickness=0
extrusion=0,0,1
